intro: It sounds like you might be going through something really painful. I'm an AI, so I can't support you the way a person can, but you don't have to face this alone. You can talk to someone right now:

lines.label: In the United States
lines.text: call or text 988, or chat at https://988lifeline.org (the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).

lines.label: In Canada
lines.text: call or text 9-8-8, any time (the 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline).

lines.label: In the UK
lines.text: call Samaritans free on 116 123, any time.

lines.label: In Ireland
lines.text: call Samaritans free on 116 123, any time, or text HELLO to 50808 (Text About It).

lines.label: In New Zealand
lines.text: call or text 1737 free, any time.

elsewhere.label: Anywhere else
elsewhere.text: find a free, confidential helpline near you at https://findahelpline.com.

emergency.known: If you are in immediate danger, call {number}.
emergency.unknown: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
